content_fields.title: Verify that software is configured to have secure settings by default
content_fields.description: Add a startup assertion and a test that prove the secure defaults hold.
content_fields.finding: The insecure fallbacks apply silently whenever the environment variables are absent, so there is no secure-by-default baseline to verify.
content_fields.current_code:
class Settings:
    JWT_SECRET_KEY = os.getenv("JWT_SECRET_KEY", generate_random_secret())
    CHEF_USERNAME = os.getenv("CHEF_USERNAME", "chef")

    JWT_VERIFY_SIGNATURE = os.getenv("JWT_VERIFY_SIGNATURE")

    POSTGRES_USER: str = os.getenv("POSTGRES_USER", "admin")
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD = os.getenv("POSTGRES_PASSWORD", "password")
    POSTGRES_SERVER: str = os.getenv("POSTGRES_SERVER", "localhost")
    POSTGRES_PORT: str = os.getenv("POSTGRES_PORT", 5432)
    POSTGRES_DB: str = os.getenv("POSTGRES_DB", "restaurant")
criteria: A test asserts the application refuses to start for each missing required setting.
A test asserts no default value equals a known weak literal.
